item.tib: me ri gsang ba dpa' bo gyad phur gyi sgrub thabs mngon par rtogs pa zab lam gnad kyi 'khor lo
item.coloph: de ltar me ri gsang ba gyad phur gyi sgrab thabs mngon par rtogs par zab lam gnad kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba 'di ni/ 'di nyid rnal 'byor la brtson pa'i bla ma mang po'i zhabs rdul spyi bor blang zhing / rang nyid 'di yi rnal 'byor la brtson par 'dod pa/ mdo khams khyung po'i sa char skyes pa'i sgo rigs kyi btsun pa brtson 'grus 'od zer zhes bya bas/ rang nyid kyi brjed thor dpal 'byor rdzong gi gtsug lag khang gi mdun phyogs shar gling du yi ger btab/ nyes 'gal gyur srid lha tshogs bla mar bcas/ mkhas pa'i tshogs dang srung ma rnams la mthol/ dge bas 'gro kun bde chen gnas slebs nas/ sku gsum mgon po'i go 'phang myur 'thob (thob shog)/
